verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public API for HumanLayer, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 on every candidate path. The only programmatic surface is the CLI: `humanlayer automation run` starts one session, and launch tokens handle remote daemons. That is an adjacent automation feature, not an API with parity to the UI. Most UI capabilities (comments and review, metrics, draft PR creation, multiplayer drafts, task management) have no documented programmatic equivalent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
